title: Everything you need to know about AI Agents in n8n 👇 An AI Agent is a system that can think,
description:
Everything you need to know about AI Agents in n8n 👇

An AI Agent is a system that can think, remember, and take action for you. In n8n, you build one with three parts:

1. A chat model (the brain)
2. Memory (so it learns from past interactions)
3. Tools (Gmail, Slack, APIs) to actually do work

No code. Just real automation that acts, not just chats.
